summary: Road teams won nine of the 12 games on Wednesday. Memphis won a game with 22 lead changes in Cleveland on Cameron Boozer's go-ahead free throws, Philadelphia came back from 17 down in Orlando, and Jamal Murray's late jumper lifted Denver past Boston. Chicago beat Brooklyn by 30, the night's widest margin, and Sacramento's Darius Acuff Jr. scored a night-high 36 points in a loss to Phoenix.

games.headline: Grizzlies hold off Mitchell to win in Cleveland
games.story: The game had 22 lead changes and 14 ties, and Cleveland's biggest lead was 10 in the second quarter. Cameron Boozer's two free throws with 1:26 left put Memphis ahead 120-119 for good, and Taylor Hendricks and Cedric Coward each made two more in the final 21 seconds. Cam Spencer led the Grizzlies with 26 points on 9-of-11 shooting, including 5 of 6 from 3-point range, and Boozer added 18 points, eight rebounds and four steals. Donovan Mitchell scored 34 for the Cavaliers, who were without Evan Mobley.

games.headline: Rockets roll past Pacers behind Sheppard's six 3s
games.story: Houston went ahead for good at 9-8 in the first quarter, added a 15-0 run later in the period and led 62-46 at halftime. Indiana cut a 19-point deficit to 72-65 with a 12-0 run in the third quarter, but the Rockets pushed the lead to 21 in the fourth. Reed Sheppard made 6 of 7 3-pointers for 20 points, and Kevin Durant scored 21 on 7-of-9 shooting as Houston made 19 threes to Indiana's 10. Pascal Siakam had 24 points for the Pacers, who were without Tyrese Haliburton and Andrew Nembhard.

games.headline: Heat lead all the way and hold off Bucks' late push
games.story: Miami never trailed, led 74-48 at halftime and went up by 30 early in the third quarter. Milwaukee scored 44 points in the fourth, including a 12-0 run and the game's last 11 points, to finish seven back. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 27 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists, Bam Adebayo scored 26, and Davion Mitchell made 6 of 7 3-pointers for 24. Kyle Kuzma led the Bucks with 26 points.

games.headline: 76ers rally from 17 down to beat Magic
games.story: Orlando led 36-19 late in the first quarter and 97-92 after three. Jalen Suggs's 3-pointer gave the Magic a 112-111 lead with 2:01 left, but VJ Edgecombe answered with a 3 at 1:36 and Philadelphia never trailed again. Joel Embiid had 26 points, seven assists and three blocks, Edgecombe scored 24 in 43 minutes, and LeBron James added 22. Franz Wagner had 27 points, eight rebounds and 11 assists for Orlando, which was without Paolo Banchero.

games.headline: Bulls rout Nets by 30 in Brooklyn
games.story: Chicago went ahead for good at 3-2 in the opening minutes, closed the first quarter on a 13-0 run and led 76-51 at halftime. The lead reached 37 late in the third quarter. Matas Buzelis scored 25 points with five 3-pointers, and Josh Giddey had 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists as the Bulls made 53 of 99 shots and had 36 assists. Egor Dëmin led Brooklyn with 22 points, and the Nets committed 20 turnovers.

games.headline: Wizards pull away in the fourth to edge Raptors
games.story: Toronto led 79-78 after three quarters, and Washington used an 11-0 run early in the fourth to turn an 82-80 deficit into a 91-82 lead. The Wizards led by 10 with under four minutes left, and the Raptors got within 102-99 with 27 seconds to go but did not score again. Anthony Davis had 25 points and 14 rebounds, and AJ Dybantsa added 23 points and 12 rebounds. Immanuel Quickley scored 24 for Toronto, which was without Scottie Barnes, Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett.

games.headline: Pistons pull away from Pelicans in New Orleans
games.story: The teams were tied 14 times before Detroit went ahead for good at 49-46 midway through the second quarter, and the Pistons led 67-60 at halftime. Detroit built a 19-point lead in the fourth quarter. John Collins scored 20 with four 3-pointers, Javonte Green had 18, and Paul Reed added 17 on 7-of-9 shooting, while Cade Cunningham did not play. Zion Williamson scored 24 and Jordan Poole 22 for New Orleans, which made 11 of 28 3-pointers to Detroit's 17 of 32.

games.headline: Hawks beat Thunder behind Okongwu's 28 points
games.story: Atlanta used a 12-0 second-quarter run to lead 64-51 at halftime, but Oklahoma City outscored the Hawks 32-19 in the third and the game was tied at 83 going into the fourth. The Hawks went ahead for good at 89-86 early in the fourth, then pulled away with an 8-0 run for a 102-92 lead. Onyeka Okongwu scored 28 with five 3-pointers, and Jalen Johnson had 16 points, 12 rebounds and 11 assists. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 34 for the Thunder, who were without Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams.

games.headline: Flagg scores 33 as Mavericks beat Warriors
games.story: Dallas broke a 6-6 tie with a 12-0 run in the first quarter, never trailed again and led by as many as 29 in the third. Cooper Flagg scored 33 points on 11-of-15 shooting with nine assists and four steals, and P.J. Washington added 21 with five 3-pointers. Will Richard led Golden State with 20 points, and the Warriors made 9 of 38 3-pointers. Golden State was without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Al Horford.

games.headline: Murray's late jumper lifts Nuggets past Celtics
games.story: Boston led 61-44 late in the second quarter, but Denver took the lead with a 12-0 run in the third, and it was 80-80 after three. Neemias Queta's putback put the Celtics up 101-100 with 1:06 left, DeMar DeRozan answered with two free throws, and Jamal Murray's jumper with seven seconds left made it 104-101. Nikola Jokić had 24 points, eight rebounds and nine assists, and Murray scored 21 with four steals. Jayson Tatum led Boston with 24 points, and Queta had 17 points and 10 rebounds.

games.headline: Jazz break away late with 15-0 run to beat Lakers
games.story: The game was tied 14 times, the last at 83-83 with just over eight minutes left, before Utah scored 15 straight points to lead 98-83. The Jazz led by as many as 18 in the final two minutes. Keyonte George had 30 points and 10 assists, and Ace Bailey added 19 points and eight rebounds. Luka Dončić scored 29 on 10-of-28 shooting for the Lakers, who were without Austin Reaves.

games.headline: Suns pull away from Kings despite Acuff's 36
games.story: Phoenix went ahead for good at 30-29 late in the first quarter, and a 12-0 run in the third turned an 80-74 lead into 92-74. The Kings cut it to 106-96 in the fourth before another 12-0 Suns run, and the lead reached 27. Devin Booker and Dillon Brooks scored 29 points each, with Brooks making 12 of 18 shots, and Jalen Green added 18 points, seven rebounds and seven assists. Darius Acuff Jr. scored a night-high 36 for Sacramento.
